rationale: Canonical priority-tier classification for the AAA Cert Epic (Tier 3). P0 = interactive + healthcare-critical components committed to AAA conformance per WCAG 2.1 + APG-aligned keyboard contracts. P1 = data display + progress + special-case components committed to AA-strict + AAA-informational. P2 = indicators + structural layout (AA-inherited; AAA where the component happens to qualify). Exempt = utility/theming primitives with no contrast obligation.

p0.rationale: Interactive primitives, healthcare-critical surfaces, form controls, and the icon primitive (hx-icon — non-text-contrast surface consumed by 30+ components and certed against WCAG 1.4.11). AAA-certified per the 11 component-shippable criteria (1.4.6, 1.4.9, 2.1.3, 2.3.3, 2.4.12, 2.4.13, 2.5.5, 3.2.5, 3.3.6, forced-colors, APG-aligned keyboard contract). VPAT v1.0 publishes when 30+ of these reach AAA-cert.

p1.rationale: Data display, progress indicators, healthcare-specific surfaces. Committed to AA-strict + AAA-informational. Keyboard contracts published; AAA contrast met where structurally possible.

p2.rationale: Indicators, structural/layout primitives, decorative content. AA-inherited from token cascade; AAA where the surface naturally qualifies (e.g., text on default surfaces). No per-component AAA cert obligation; documented in VPAT as Pending audit / Not Evaluated until escalated.

exempt.rationale: Utility / theming primitives. No contrast obligation, no interactive surface, no rendered content of their own. Documented in VPAT as Out of Scope.

v1ReleaseTrigger.comment: VPAT v1.0 auto-promotes when 30+ P0 components carry @aaa-certified JSDoc + AAA-AUDIT.md + axe-AAA pass. Records: scripts/a11y-aaa-allowlist.json (allow-list) + custom-elements.json (aaaCertified field) + per-component AAA-AUDIT.md.

consumers.purpose: Live cert-count badges + per-tier coverage matrix
Per-component conformance rows; v0.1 → v1.0 promotion trigger
Validates target component is in P0 before applying cert; rejects P1/P2/exempt names
Metadata-completeness gate — every P0 must declare aaa-criteria, keyboard-contract, aria-pattern, priority-tier
